summary: Quantifies and visualizes differential gene expression across cortical cell subclasses between pre- and post-eye-opening developmental stages using pseudobulk statistical methods.
use_when: How do gene expression profiles change in cortical subclasses after eye-opening?
Generate volcano plots for developmental DGE across cell types
Calculate log2 fold-change for genes regulated by sensory experience
Perform subclass-specific differential expression analysis between P7 and P14
Summarize upregulated and downregulated genes across cortical developmental windows
avoid_when: The required input data contract is not satisfied
